summary.text: Pylian whom Nestor arrayed beside mighty Pelagon, Chromius, lord Haemon, and Bias shepherd of the host — distinct from goodly Alastor comrade of Mecisteus and from the Lycian Alastor whom Diomedes and Odysseus slew.

story.text: When Agamemnon came to Nestor arraying his comrades, the clear-voiced orator of the Pylians had drawn up mighty Pelagon and Alastor and Chromius and lord Haemon and Bias, setting charioteers with their cars before the footmen.
